project: Wuxia Life Early Childhood Spine Origin Isolation (Stage-6)
description: Stage-6 spine/story_event origin hard isolation for ages 0–7: canonical primary origin resolver, runtime gate in getAvailableEvents/selectEvent path, P22 catalog flag fixes, four-origin regression matrix, API playtest bleed detector, and CI config validation. Stage-5 passive isolation must not regress. Product truth: docs/PRD/early-childhood-spine-origin-isolation.md; design rules: docs/designs/spine-origin-isolation-rules.md.

userStories.title: Hard Origin Gate For Spine Events (Age 0–7)
userStories.description: As a player, I want story events at ages 0–7 to match my chosen origin so that childhood spine feels coherent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add isSpineOriginEligible(event, primaryOriginFlag, age) (or equivalent) per design §3.2
Wire gate into GameEngineIntegration.getAvailableEvents or passesRuntimeEventGuards for age <= 7 after live_ops and before weighted pick (FR-1)
Origin-exclusive events (design §3.2) must not pass when primary flag mismatches; neutral/general ids (clever_speech, childhood_preference, origin_background, …) unchanged
p22_origin_frontier_orphan not selectable for origin_scholar_family primary even if origin_poor_family trait flag is set (FR-2, FR-3)
Apply gate to dailyEventSystem fallback when fallback event carries origin-exclusive semantics (PRD §12 Q3 default: yes)
New unit tests in tests/spineOriginIsolationTests.ts
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-003; §3 frozen (hard filter over weighting, 0–2 passive chains unchanged, 3–7 passive selector unchanged); §7 GameEngineIntegration.ts touchpoints; §10 risk over-filtering → US-001 neutral whitelist; gate age P0 band 0–7 (Q1: implementation may use <=12 constant); depends on US-002 resolver
